#### Summary

#### What changed
- Updated approval overlay to display network-specific approval context
(host/protocol).
- Added/updated TUI wiring so approval prompts show correct network
messaging.

workflow_runs.display_title: fix: add timeout to MCP elicitation requests to prevent indefinite hangs

head_commit.message:
fix: add timeout to MCP elicitation requests to prevent indefinite hangs (#11816)

When an MCP client does not support elicitation (or fails to respond),
approval requests for command execution and patch application would
block indefinitely, causing the tool call to hang forever.

Changes:
- Add 30-second timeout to elicitation await in exec_approval.rs
- Add 30-second timeout to elicitation await in patch_approval.rs
- Submit Denied decision on timeout (fail-safe) with descriptive error
- Fix exec_approval error branch to submit Denied (was silently returning)

The timeout ensures that:
1. Non-elicitation MCP clients get a clear error instead of hanging
2. Head-of-line blocking is prevented for multi-tool scenarios
3. Commands are denied (not approved) when approval cannot be obtained

Fixes openai#11816

feat(tui): render structured network approval prompts in approval overlay (#11674)

### Description
#### Summary
Adds the TUI UX layer for structured network approvals

#### What changed
- Updated approval overlay to display network-specific approval context
(host/protocol).
- Added/updated TUI wiring so approval prompts show correct network
messaging.
- Added tests covering the new approval overlay behavior.

#### Why
Core orchestration can now request structured network approvals; this
ensures users see clear, contextual prompts in the TUI.

#### Notes
- UX behavior activates only when network approval context is present.

head_commit.message:
feat(core): add structured network approval plumbing and policy decision model (#11672)

### Description
#### Summary
Introduces the core plumbing required for structured network approvals

#### What changed
- Added structured network policy decision modeling in core.
- Added approval payload/context types needed for network approval
semantics.
- Wired shell/unified-exec runtime plumbing to consume structured
decisions.
- Updated related core error/event surfaces for structured handling.
- Updated protocol plumbing used by core approval flow.
- Included small CLI debug sandbox compatibility updates needed by this
layer.

#### Why
establishes the minimal backend foundation for network approvals without
yet changing high-level orchestration or TUI behavior.

#### Notes
- Behavior remains constrained by existing requirements/config gating.
- Follow-up PRs in the stack handle orchestration, UX, and app-server
integration.

---------

### Description
#### Summary
Introduces the core plumbing required for structured network approvals

#### What changed
- Added structured network policy decision modeling in core.
- Added approval payload/context types needed for network approval
semantics.
- Wired shell/unified-exec runtime plumbing to consume structured
decisions.

- Updated protocol plumbing used by core approval flow.
- Included small CLI debug sandbox compatibility updates needed by this
layer.

establishes the minimal backend foundation for network approvals without
yet changing high-level orchestration or TUI behavior.

#### Notes
- Behavior remains constrained by existing requirements/config gating.
- Follow-up PRs in the stack handle orchestration, UX, and app-server
integration.
